_comment: S20. One entry per acceptance test. Only `passes` may be flipped; never reword an entry.

features.description: A Flow Tool row importing a bare module-level callable resolves gated, even with requires_confirmation unticked on the record.
A row inserted while the import flag is set gets no doctype default (measured, not cited) and resolves gated anyway.
An imported Tool object's own declaration still decides, in both directions: ungated stays ungated, gated cannot be un-gated by the record.
A shipped read-only builtin row resolves ungated.
The record can still turn a gate ON, including over code that declares it does not need one.
An import_path resolving to neither a Tool nor a callable is still refused.
The approval question built for such a tool names no platform, vendor or model, and the check that says so can itself go red.
A Script tool inserted as a fixture resolves gated, so arbitrary sandboxed code cannot run with nobody asked.
A Script tool created at a desk is gated too: the default and the floor agree.
